title: Easily Auto-Post to Google My Business Profile from WordPress - Bit Social

facts.fact: The article 'Easily Auto-Post to Google My Business Profile from WordPress' was published on 16-Jun-2026 by Sadia Humaira.
The page states that its reading time is 5 minutes.
Bit Social's own guide presents the WP Auto Post procedure as a five-step process.
facts.quote: **Step 5:** Check “**Logs**” whether it is published or not.

facts.fact: According to the page, Bit Social offers two ways to connect a Google Business Profile: One Click and Custom App.
facts.quote: You can do this in two ways– **One Click** and **Custom App**.

facts.fact: According to the page, Bit Social's 'Share post type' setting can be set to post, page, product, or media.
facts.quote: Select the “**Share post type**” whether it’s a post, page, product, or media.

facts.fact: According to the page, enabling Bit Social's 'Share posts automatically' option shares posts on all active social accounts automatically.
facts.quote: Enable the “**Share posts automatically**” option, to share the post on all active social accounts automatically.

facts.fact: Bit Social's own scheduling guide describes the WP Post Schedule procedure as three steps.
